integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically from shortest-path response structure and exact recontamination. Computation is used only as a finite stress test. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and to the partial/full feedback rules of the cited directional localization game. The finite verifier covers total order at most eight and is not an infinite proof. A residual originality risk is concurrent or poorly indexed work on this very recent invariant.
title: Directional localization of complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts
